author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

GO:0033617 | mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase assembly | IBA with PTN001024046 , S000001848


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC2C4.09 (but any)

This protein isn't very well characterised and has conflicting annotation in  cerevisiae and human. Probably should not be transferred yet.

mitochondrial protein, implicated in regulation of proline metabolism (S. cerevisiae), and calcium import (human)



* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: GO:0033617 | mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase assembly | IBA with PTN001024046

author: marcfeuermann
body: Indeed, the evidence is not well supported yet... and yeast is often over-annotated with "complex assembly". terms. I removed the annotation.  Again the PTN ID was not complete in the title.
